about_the_game:
WARNING: This video game may potentially trigger seizures for people with photosensitive epilepsy. Player discretion is advised.


A Haunting That Never Ends:

Psycho is a first-person psychological horror game that traps you in a photorealistic house doomed to repeat the same night. Each loop begins in the same hallway, but the house changes, twisting deeper into a waking nightmare of shifting rooms, buried memories, and a presence that watches from the shadows. Inspired by P.T., Psycho delivers slow-burn horror with no HUD, no tutorials, and no mercy.

Every Loop Tells a Story:

You’re reliving the aftermath of a tragedy you don’t fully understand. Through distorted radios, torn journal pages, and forgotten cassette tapes, a tale of grief, betrayal, and guilt unfolds, but only if you pay attention. Meanwhile, a feral entity stalks you relentlessly. You have no weapons. only glass bottles to defend yourself. Use them wisely, or not at all.

Features:

  • Haunted Time Loop: The house reshapes itself with every cycle, revealing new secrets and escalating the psychological terror in an endless, ever-changing nightmare.

  • Hunted by an Unscripted Stalker: A relentless entity hunts you through the halls. You cannot fight it, only run, hide, and pray it loses your trail.

  • Puzzles Born from Fear: Your progress is earned by solving cryptic, environmental puzzles. There are no hints; only your wits can guide you through the darkness.

  • One Fragile Defense: Drinking bottles are your only tool against the horror. Use it to stun the enemy and escape or save it for a true moment of desperation.

  • Total Immersive Storytelling: The world itself tells the story through ghostly radio broadcasts, abandoned notes, and eerie sounds. with no HUD to break the mode.

  • Photorealistic Psychological Horror: Hyper-realistic visuals and a chilling soundscape pull you into a living nightmare where every shadow and whisper feels terrifyingly real.

  • Psycho is a short psychological horror inspired by genre pioneers like P.T, Granny and Alien isolation.

Continuous Updates:

We are committed to making Psycho as immersive as possible. Both the full game and the demo receive regular updates to enhance your experience. Your feedback is invaluable. Report any bugs or suggest new features in our discussion section or connect with us through our social media channels. Your input helps shape the game!

content_descriptors.notes: This game explores disturbing psychological themes, including trauma, emotional distress, and mental health struggles. The narrative includes an optional ending involving a suicide attempt.

short_description: You’re trapped in an endless nightmare, reliving the same haunted night over and over. Every time you escape your house, reality resets. Haunted by grief and stalked by a relentless presence, can you solve the twisted puzzles and face the truth to break the loop?
